goal: A session whose workspace has no active task and no active batch does not write Immune-Brain hook events: on PostToolUse, SubagentStart, SubagentStop and SessionEnd the Claude hook appends to the event log only for active work, while PreToolUse and UserPromptSubmit behave as before and hooks.json keeps its registrations (Spec host-owned-environment S5; D15, I9).

acceptance.assertion: Through the hook entry with a temporary state root: with an active task and with an active batch each of the four events appends to the event log; with neither, none of the four appends anything; UserPromptSubmit still records a phase entry when no task exists; seam: tests/claude-host-authority.test.ts (Spec SCN-12, SCN-13, D15, I9).

The existing asynchronous Reviewer evidence tests pass unchanged and the generated Claude bundle matches the runtime source; seams: tests/claude-review-host-async-agent.test.ts, tests/claude-host-package.test.ts (Spec SCN-13, I9).
